race.comment: Keen to stick with the lightly raced KOMITO (8) who made a nice step forward second up at Sandown Hillside, sitting close to a strong pace and relishing the test to win well over Blue Willow who has won since. The rise to 2100m looks ideal off that and he should be able to go on with it here. Outside of him it's a bit of a raffle. DURBAN HARBOUR (9) put in a good run at Seymour last time to grab third and should be rock hard fit now with the wet track to suit. GIGGENBACH (11) got home well behind KOMITO last start at a big price and now meets the winner 3.5kg better with Shinn taking over. Fitter fourth-up and is a genuine chance to turn the tables. DON'T DOUBT DARE (14) has been holding her own against tougher opposition in town of late and deserves consideration too.
